theorem: The protected/E6 45 is reconstructible from the binary code alone. The code-intrinsic 36-minimum-word Jacobi graph has 135 maximal K4s; their anticompleteness graph is exactly 45 disjoint triangles, and each triangle's three K4s unite to one 12-subset of the 36 carrier. The 45 unions form the protected/E6 45 under an explicit PSp-equivariant stabilizer map.
